qa.question: When did Brown 12 reach the pre-construction step?
qa.finding: The draft Kentucky air permit V-26-036 lists a Combined Cycle Project permit revision (activity APE20250001) dated May 26, 2025. LG&E/KU also filed the certificate application on February 28, 2025 in case 2025-00045.
qa.recommendation: Date the pre-construction step May 2025, from the air permit revision. If the team counts the certificate application instead, use February 2025.
qa.note: The permit document is at https://dep.gateway.ky.gov/eSearch.WebApi/api/documentGenerate/getDocument/14473287 and the commission order is at https://psc.ky.gov/pscscf/2025%20Cases/2025-00045//20251028_PSC_ORDER.pdf. The permit table gives a complete date, which may differ from the date the application was first received.

qa.question: Is Brown 12 start year 2030 or 2029?
qa.finding: The commission order of October 28, 2025 says the unit is to be in service by 2030. The Oil and Gas Watch page lists an expected operating year of 2029 or 2030.
qa.recommendation: Leave the start year at 2030, which a commission order supports.
qa.note: I read the page at https://oilandgaswatch.org/facility/rec_d4f1u5gq7easr8ra1evg with a full browser load after the plain fetch returned only an empty shell. The page data comes from a protected interface, so the browser load was the way in.

qa.question: Does the 2024 LG&E/KU resource plan name Brown 12?
qa.finding: The plan at https://psc.ky.gov/pscecf/2024-00326/rick.lovekamp%40lge-ku.com/10182024014139/06-LGE_KU_2024_IRP_Volume_I.pdf adds combined cycle units without naming Brown 12 in the text I searched, and it retires Brown 3 in 2035 on the coal side.
qa.recommendation: Make no change from the plan. Brown 3 retirement in 2035 belongs on the coal tracker.
qa.note: I searched the plan text for Brown 12 and Brown combined cycle and found only Brown 3 mentions. The commission order of October 2025 is the better source for Brown 12.

qa.question: Was the Brown data center fleet check answered?
qa.finding: No permit in the harvest matched a data center engine fleet at Brown. The Brown Title V draft lists the combined cycle project, not a backup engine fleet.
qa.recommendation: Leave Backup Power as no on all units.
